system.description:
A short length of wood sharpened at one end - a humble weapon that has nonetheless been the downfall of many vampires over the centuries.

Negative Traits: Short

Concealability: Jacket

Damage: One health level

Availability: Any

Special Ability - Staking: Can pierce the heart of a vampire (paralyzing her) if the wielder wins or ties two successive Simple Tests after striking.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Rules, Systems and Drama
